product: Google Search Console connector is available in Beta
tagline: The managed Google Search Console connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect.
what_it_does: The managed Google Search Console connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect. Use it to ingest search performance data, site metadata, and sitemap information from Google Search Console into Databricks. The connector supports daily and hourly search analytics dimensions (date, country, device, page, query), as well as verified sites and submitted sitemaps.
